page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.6xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware specifications include 24 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-vCPU allocation of 8.0 GB per core.

Network connectivity features an 18 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There is no bundled local storage, meaning stateful implementations rely entirely on detached network block storage volumes. Dedicated hardware accelerators are not included, with a GPU count of zero.

The combination of dedicated 3.3 GHz processor cores with an elevated 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio makes the instance suited for tasks constrained by both memory footprint and single-thread execution latency. Qualitative cost efficiency centers on its dense memory provisioning paired with high-frequency CPU cores, offering effective resource consolidation for in-memory databases, caching systems, analytics pipelines, and large enterprise applications without local disk dependencies.
